## WF-1 SOC Triage
Agents advise, code routes, humans approve.
Orchestrator, lookups, scoring, guardrails and routing are deterministic code. The five agents run through SW-1. Every failure path lands in the Exception Handler (E, manual queue).

### Routing (A/H/E)
0 ESCALATE → E, then H approval by Tier 2 / Lead
1 REVIEW → H analyst review
2 CONFIRM_CLOSURE → H analyst confirms
3 EXCEPTION (agent flagged injection) → E
